title: R’ Oshaya, son of Rav Idi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is thus mentioned in [Yevamot 36b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.36b.12): “Rav Ashi said to him.” Hyman calls this a scribal error and says it should read “Rav Yehoshua son of Rav Idi,” as cited there [on 37a in Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Yevamot.37a.2.1).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The correction from Oshaya to Rav Yehoshua is Hyman’s, citing Rashi at Yevamot 37a.

The linked Gemara has Rav Ashi addressing Rav Hoshaya son of Rav Idi, as [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=287&lang=en) records. The linked Rashi has ר׳ יהושע בריה דרב אידי. Hyman takes this as grounds to read Rav Yehoshua son of Rav Idi in the Gemara.
